premise: Rabbit hops ahead and back, waiting for Snail; when he finally walks at Snail's pace he sees a dewdrop, a caterpillar and a flower opening that he had always hopped past.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: there is no race and no loser; slowness has treasures the fast one never noticed.
lesson: Slow down and you see more.

en-US.title: Rabbit Walks with Snail
en-US.text: {sfx:meadow} Rabbit {rabbit:hop x3} went everywhere at a hop. {sfx:boing} Boing, boing, boing! Snail {snail:pulse} went everywhere at a slide. Sliiide. One morning they set off to see the tree. {tree:pulse} [rushed] Rabbit hopped to the tree and back. Come ON, Snail! Snail slid one snail-step. [slowly] I am coming, said Snail. I am always coming. [sighs] Rabbit sat down next to Snail. And then he walked. One slow step. Another. And that is when he saw it. [gasps] A dewdrop on a blade of grass, with a tiny rainbow inside. He had hopped over it every day. A caterpillar, munch munch. And Flower, {flower:glow} opening. Slowly. Petal by petal. He had never once seen a flower open. [softly] Snail, he whispered. Is it always like this? {snail:hearts} Always, said Snail. You just have to walk. They reached the tree at lunchtime, which was fine. The tree had not gone anywhere.

es-ES.title: Conejo pasea con Caracol
es-ES.text: {sfx:meadow} Conejo {rabbit:hop x3} iba a todas partes a saltos. {sfx:boing} ¡Boing, boing, boing! Caracol {snail:pulse} iba a todas partes deslizándose. Desliiiza. Una mañana salieron juntos a ver el árbol. {tree:pulse} [rushed] Conejo llegó al árbol y volvió. ¡VENGA, Caracol! Caracol dio un paso de caracol. [slowly] Ya voy, dijo Caracol. Yo siempre voy. [sighs] Conejo se sentó a su lado. Y luego se puso a andar. Un paso lento. Otro. Y entonces lo vio. [gasps] Una gota de rocío en una brizna de hierba, con un arcoíris chiquitito dentro. Había saltado por encima cien veces. Una oruga, ñam, ñam. Y Flor, {flower:glow} abriéndose. Despacio. Pétalo a pétalo. Nunca había visto abrirse una flor. [softly] Caracol, susurró. ¿Siempre es así? {snail:hearts} Siempre, dijo Caracol. Solo hay que andar. Y llegaron al árbol a la hora de comer, y no pasó nada, porque el árbol no se había movido de sitio.

meadow.prompt: a sunny meadow morning, soft breeze in grass and a few distant bees

boing.prompt: three quick springy boings, like a small animal bouncing along, cartoonish and light
